decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the 44Ω value, optional population policy, and signal-quality purpose; no additional candidate-state change is required.
The source changes I2C cable-length and series-resistor policy, not the interboard connector architecture, connector types, or pin assignments.
The I2C series-resistor decision does not change the standalone USB power source, activation condition, LDO capacity, or powered scope.
The reference to resistors complicating layout is conditional population guidance and does not alter the board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, connector placement, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The source concerns SDA/SCL series resistors and has no effect on the switched 5V boost rail, its enable control, or its loads.
The 44Ω SDA/SCL resistors are unrelated to the charge-status connector, CHGLED circuitry, D1 population, and R6 value.
The source does not change the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology or VSYS labeling.
The I2C signal-conditioning decision does not affect Schottky-diode OR-ing, power sources, or source-selection behavior.
The source does not change the battery connector, its placement or pin functions, the battery voltage range, or its AXP2101 destination.
Optional population of I2C series resistors does not change the required eight-layer stack.
The source does not affect the USB-C connector's data-line capability or sourceability requirements.
The source neither changes the required LCSC part numbers nor addresses the documented roles of R7, R8, R10, or R11; generic resistor overlap is incidental.
